subject: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — SparkWave Analytics opportunity
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@sparkwave.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: AWS ACE registration request — SparkWave Analytics / Redwood Inference

Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking a look at SparkWave last week. We had a productive product call and leadership here is ready to pursue an AWS co-sell route while we finalize procurement. We’d like to get started with the ACE registration process so we can be positioned for co-sell engagement with the AWS account teams.

Quick context: SparkWave is an analytics platform for streaming telemetry (primarily FinOps & SRE use cases). The initial pilot would be for two enterprise customers (expected combined ACV ~ $180k ARR, 12 month initial term) — likely to move to production in Q1.

As next steps, can you:
- confirm we can kick off ACE registration and who from Redwood will be the PDM & PSM contacts
- share an intake checklist you need (AWS asks, estimated timeline)
- propose 30 min tomorrow or Thursday for a short intake call with our procurement and technical leads?

Attaching our product one-pager for quick reference.

Attachments: sparkwave-product-onepager.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
Tara Singh
Head of Partnerships | SparkWave Analytics
T: +1 415-555-0132
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@sparkwave.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS ACE registration request — SparkWave Analytics / Redwood Inference

Hi Tara — great to hear and thanks for the one-pager.

We can absolutely initiate ACE registration. To get the intake completed quickly, a few items we need from your side before the call:
- expected ACV and contract cadence (you mentioned ~$180k ARR; please confirm)
- AWS account ID(s) for the customers you expect us to co-sell against (or the AWS partner account ID)
- primary technical contact and procurement contact (name + email)
- any compliance requests (SOC2, data residency) that must be called out now

Proposed times for a 30-min intake: tomorrow (11/09) 10:00-10:30 PT or Thursday (11/11) 13:00-13:30 PT. If neither works, send over preferred windows and we’ll adapt.

Vanessa (PSM) and Karthik (PDM) are looped for intro — they’ll drive the co-sell pairing and intake on our side. I’ll also start the ACE registration in AWS while we confirm details so we don’t lose momentum.

Next steps I will take this afternoon: create the ACE intake doc and share a draft; open a HubSpot opportunity and link it to ACE registration.

Best,

—
Logan Wright
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
log: 555-0104
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@sparkwave.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS ACE registration request — SparkWave Analytics / Redwood Inference

Thanks — looping in some operational detail from the PDM side. I can own the PDM pairing for SparkWave and will be point for AWS alignment. Vanessa, can you confirm you’ll own PSM activities (enablement + onboarding once ACE is accepted)?

Operational checklist I’ll cover:
- ACE intake fields (solution description, target customer list, estimated timeline)
- Success metrics we’ll propose to AWS (pilot accounts, expected deployment date)
- Partner contacts we’ll register (PDM/PSM/technical lead)

Tara — on the intake call, it would help if you can have procurement and engineering on the line so we can capture AWS account IDs and anticipated purchase order timelines. If you can drop the three fields below in advance it will speed the registration:
1) Confirmed ACV for the initial 12 months
2) AWS account IDs or Partner Account ID
3) Any legal/contract obligations (PO terms, indemnity clauses) we should flag for marketplace listing

I’ll draft the ACE intake doc after the call and propose the co-sell plan (PDM/PSM responsibilities + AWS contact mapping). Also adding a reminder: please include the expected go-live region (us/eu/apac) in your confirmation — AWS co-sell routing depends on that.

Karthik
Principal PDM | Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@sparkwave.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement <procure@sparkwave.ai>

ACE registration reference: ACE-RED-20271108-77
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-4521

Proposed next step: 30-min intake call Friday 11/12 at 10:00 PT to finalize accounts and procurement path. Vanessa to own PSM kickoff once ACE is accepted by AWS.

Thanks —

Logan
